name: Nimras
description: Nimras: human Rank 2 Magic-User, freelance mage hunter trained by an independent fellowship. Left amicably to spread his wings. Review draft; not yet in play.
content: Nimras is a freelance mage hunter trained by an independent fellowship. He left on good terms to choose his own work and establish his independence. The fellowship has commissioned him to find his former teacher Rennic Vaur in Purewater and recover an entrusted manuscript. His introduction to Oren Vey is his first proposed lead. He holds no Crown warrant. Alignment and passions remain the player’s choice. No arrival, target sighting or scene has been played.

myth-equipment-json.name: Hemp rope (30 ft; purchased for 1 GP)

myth-powers-json.name: Mental Strength
myth-powers-json.effect: Once per day, mental-magic resistance Willpower tests are two difficulty grades easier. Disbelieving illusions and phantasms is one grade easier.

myth-extras-json.build_status: Active player character; session begun at d6/dusk.

background.profession: Freelance mage hunter and battle mage
background.training: An independent magical fellowship, name not yet chosen.
background.departure: Left amicably to spread his wings and choose his own work; no bad blood.
background.commission: Find his former teacher Rennic Vaur in Purewater, bring him home alive, and recover the entrusted manuscript he took.
background.lead: An introduction to Oren Vey, proposed as Vaur’s last known correspondent.
background.authority: No Crown warrant; fellowship training does not make him an Assayer.
background.style: Direct battle magic, protection and pursuit; precise skills, spells and abilities unchosen.
background.creation_status: Characteristics and core concept agreed; sheet, spellbook, passions, employer name, payment and personal equipment unfinished.
background.continuity: Join the existing Purewater campaign at d6/dusk after the tournament and Hanzo’s departure. No rewind or advance.

skill_allocation.limits: 100 culture (5-15 each), 100 class (max 15), 300 Rank 2 bonus (max 30 each).

myth-extras-json.spell_learning: Read Magic plus 14 cantrips and 7 Rank 1 spells at Arcane Knowledge 70; 3 spells gained on reaching Rank 2. No extra spells awarded.

wealth.contract_advance: Amount not established; not added to starting wealth.

cfi_rules_notes: Rank 2: base 2 AP +1; base POW Luck 3 + human 1 + Rank 2 table 1 =5.
CON+SIZ 25: use CFI HP table, then +1 in each location at Rank 2.
INT/4 memory fractions rounded down following engine skill guidance.
Rank 2 spells cost normally; lower-rank spell final costs reduced by 2 per rank difference, minimum 1 MP.
No spell is forgotten merely by successful casting. Arcane casting requires freedom from armour and shields.
No additional paid Rank abilities granted; no unspent advancement budget invented.
Locale and Customs refer to his home region, not automatic knowledge of Purewater. Home region and fellowship name remain undecided.
Navigation and Track are untrained Professional skills and have not been added under other names.

outlook.manner: Tries to be pleasant and amiable.
outlook.boundaries: Does not tolerate people messing with him.
outlook.lethal_force: Willing to kill when he thinks it necessary; the player decides when that is.

portrait.scope: Appearance reference only; no added powers or equipment. Quarterstaff is already on the mechanical sheet.
portrait.prompt: Quick expressive graphite and ink character sketch on warm off-white paper of Nimras, a compact human male freelance mage hunter around thirty, healthy and moderately athletic, intelligent personable face, small easy smile, steady gaze, practical worn travelling coat over plain unarmoured clothes, boots, component pouch, well-used spellbook in a weatherproof satchel, plain wooden quarterstaff and a small fork of lightning at his free hand. Loose canal-city background inspired by Venice, confident hatching, natural human anatomy. No armour, shield, pointed hat, ornate robes, fireball, glowing eyes, text or watermark.
